fields.title: Width (in Pixel)
fields.description: The width of the output image.

fields.title: Height (in Pixel)
fields.description: The height of the output image.

fields.title: Tree scaling
fields.description: Controls how the decision tree is scaled to fit into the image area.

fields.title: Zoom
fields.description: The zoom factor applied when Fixed value scaling is selected. Values range from 0.1 (10%) to 5 (500%).

fields.title: Branch display method
fields.description: Controls which branches of the decision tree are rendered on the image.

fields.title: Unfold to level
fields.description:
The tree is unfolded from the root (level 0) down to this level. For example, entering 2 will show the
root, its children, and their children.

fields.title: Unfold with data coverage
fields.description:
All branches with a total data coverage greater than this threshold are unfolded.
Values range from 0 to 1.

fields.title: Display table
fields.description:
If checked, each node of the decision tree will include a table showing the class distribution of the
training data that reached that node.

fields.title: Display chart
fields.description:
If checked, each node of the decision tree will include a bar chart visualizing the class distribution.
Note that the chart is only available when the optional data input provides a column with color
information.
